discussion.title: tRPC Standalone Middleware Changing Preceding Input Validator TypeScript Infered Type?

nodes.body: Hi. This is probably just another oversight in the implementation of the feature since it's still experimental and not very battle tested. I think the inference is just wrong here; if there's a non-optional input parser for organizationId then it should be inferred as non-optional further down the chain.
Thanks for your examples. They will probably end up seeing a new life as part of the tRPC regression test set :)

I have a very similar setup but I don't use the standalone middleware myself but rather something as specified here in [reusable base procedures](https://trpc.io/docs/server/procedures#reusable-base-procedures)

Ah yeah I missed the optionality detail - in my case it's never optional and the org procedure middlewares also does auth check based on the org id and the current user. It's also good to pass the org id to the db query to sure that any record created/read/updated/deleted actually matched the passed org id, treating it as a composite id
